claims.content: To shift R^2 between C^2 JUs so that each tracked object is reported by one C^2 JU while other C^2 JUs withhold their reports to prevent cluttering the tactical plot.

goal.raw_text: To shift R^2 between C^2 JUs so that each tracked object is reported by one C^2 JU while other C^2 JUs withhold their reports to prevent cluttering the tactical plot.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C^2 JU has correlated local sensor data.

A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

trigger.raw_text: A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, a J2 PPLI message (other than J2.0) is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

claims.content: If the track is a Subsurface track, reporting responsibility procedures are different from those for Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) tracks.
For Subsurface tracks, the first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number.

For Subsurface tracks, no other JU shall report the contact using that Track Number unless a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received containing the TN or a J3.4 message containing the TN is not received for two consecutive periodic updates.
For Subsurface tracks, any other JU may report what it believes to be the same contact using a different TN, reporting only locally derived data.

A JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report for the track which contains a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
A JU without R2 for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0 shall assume R2 for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.

A JU assumes R2 if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.
When reporting an Inactive or Limited Status Interface Unit, the Identity shall be reported as Friend, and the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1.

If a correlation is not found, the C^2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture. If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C^2 JU still has no local data, the C^2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated. After decorrelation, the C^2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number. The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be reported as No Statement.
It is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.
A common track number is shared between C^2 JUs.
R^2 is shifted between C^2 JUs.
The tracked object is reported by one C^2 JU.
Other C^2 JUs withhold their reports.
Cluttering of the tactical plot is prevented.
